invariant: A capability or limit failure is recorded through a host-side channel whose identifying marks never appear in guest-visible error TEXT in usable form.

scenario.step1: trigger one genuine capability denial inside a guest-level catch
scenario.step2: capture whatever error representation the guest can see
scenario.step3: raise an arbitrary new failure reusing any captured identifying text

mustHold: the step-3 failure does NOT classify as capability/limit via reused text
host-side records for step-1 and step-3 are distinguishable
